Forte Capital Llc increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 198.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 8,034 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.93 million, up from 2,689 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forte Capital Llc who had been investing in Intuitive Surgical Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $51.98B market cap company. (NASDAQ:ISRG) has risen 58.43% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.88% the S&P500.
